lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for winning home wait_info tests where predictions were too low.
Adding a new screen at the finish stage (2 tests) consistently hurt completion and had to be stopped early.
Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests) and adding sign-in hints (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes (6 tests) were helpful, yielding three significant wins (+3.9%, +4.0%, and +3.6% after noise correction), while three showed no clear effect.
Evidence for most specific kinds of change remains thin because most categories have only a single test.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Arrival Progress Timeline
candidates.change: Display a detailed live progress bar and status indicator on the waiting screen showing asset preparation and desktop initialization stages.
candidates.why: Home wait time has a high mean duration of 2336s, and previous home wait_info tests produced significant completion wins (+3.6% to +4.0%).

guard.reason: Adds progress timeline to waiting screen while preserving the job of showing the pet is being made.

candidates.score_note: Strong positive history for home wait_info tests and addresses long wait time.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Activity Showcase
candidates.change: Replace static waiting screen status with an animated preview showing preview interactions of desktop pets while waiting for completion.
candidates.why: Home stage median duration is 201s; interactive visual feedback during wait steps addresses user drop-off.

guard.reason: replacement for 'waiting.wait_status' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['preview', 'progress', 'timer']

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Companion Control Hub
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro finish screen into a two-column interactive guide displaying key pet controls, hide shortcuts, and interaction triggers.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent inquiries on how to control, hide, or interact with pets after onboarding, while finish stage completion is 70.9%.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Split-View Pet Customization Studio
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend adoption screen into a side-by-side split layout showcasing companion traits and visual previews.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has a 66.2% conversion rate with 89s median duration, and support reported custom pet creation issues.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Pre-Adoption Companion Preview Stage
candidates.change: Insert a preview screen right before adoption certificate generation to render a preview of the companion's desktop presence.
candidates.why: Adoption funnel drops to 66.2% and users report custom pet creation visual errors.

new_pet_preview.headline: Preview Your Companion
new_pet_preview.body: See how your pet will look and act on your desktop.

guard.reason: Inserts a new preview screen into onboarding order without removing mandatory steps.

candidates.score_note: Addresses major bottleneck and user complaints, but adding new screens consistently decreases completion.

candidates.title: Story Screen Hero Visual Overhaul
candidates.change: Redesign the story intro screen into a full-bleed visual narrative demonstrating desktop pet features.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a 79.4% conversion and high mean duration of 514s, indicating drop-off during initial onboarding hook.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Ready Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Add desktop background notifications and status updates on the waiting screen when companion synthesis completes.
candidates.why: Home wait step averages 2336s; allowing users to switch windows safely improves retention during generation.

waiting.hint: We'll ping you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adds notification settings on waiting screen, which is explicitly allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Helps manage long wait time, but notification features lack prior testing data.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet First-Launch Command Spotlight
candidates.change: Update home_intro screen to a spotlight layout highlighting desktop hotkeys and quick action commands.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails cite confusion about hiding, summoning, or controlling desktop pets after setup.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro overlay within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Supported by funnel data and multiple support emails; layout modifications on finish stage show mild gains.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for winning home wait_info tests where predictions were too low.
Adding a new screen at the finish stage (2 tests) or adoption stage (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and had to be stopped early.
Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests) and adding sign-in hints (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes (7 tests) were helpful in three significant wins, though four tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence for most other specific kinds of change remains thin because few categories have at least two agreeing tests.
